purpose: Diagnose whether Phase-12 unseen-NLS failure is caused by insufficient transition averaging rather than representation capacity.
only_change: Use all observed transitions from context lengths 3, 5, or 8 instead of exactly 3 context frames.
typical_true_one_step_delta_mse: approximately 2.6e-5 to 2.9e-5 on these NLS ID draws
interpretation: The three-frame identifier operates in a regime where decoded transition error is much larger than the physical one-step signal. Additional independent observed transitions materially reduce estimator variance and 8-frame context passed all three fresh exploratory ID-h8 draws. This is not confirmatory evidence; it motivates a separately preregistered Phase-13 context-sufficiency test.
